messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer needs a specific item to be provided before renewal.
  quote: Appreciate it — that’s the key item for us.
- problem: The customer needs to address renewals and resolve reporting inconsistencies.
  quote: We’ve got a few things to run through today, mainly around renewals and some reporting oddities.
- problem: They need to manage renewal pricing and track repairs efficiently.
  quote: we’ve got a few things to run through, mostly around renewal pricing and repair tracking.
- problem: The customer has an urgent issue that needs immediate attention.
  quote: Just wanted to flag something urgent on our end.
- problem: The customer has unresolved items that must be addressed before their contract renewal.
  quote: We’ve got a few items we need to resolve ahead of our renewal.
- problem: The customer needs to address several items before renewal, and one has become urgent.
  quote: Hi Deryn, just checking in — we’ve got a few things we need to sort before renewal, and one’s become pretty urgent.
